title: Correct the parameter theorem and the Whitney shortcut
promptMarkdown: Write a synthesis in three parts. (a) Prove the regular-parameter/transverse-slice equivalence using the quotient by $T_zZ$. (b) For a Fredholm slice derivative $L$ and finite-dimensional $V=T_zZ$, compute the kernel and cokernel of the parameter projection and derive its index. (c) Explain why a generic immersion in $\mathbb R^{2n}$ with finite transverse double points need not already be an embedding, and state exactly the extra theorem and proof input used to reach the strong Whitney conclusion.
hintLadder: Quotient out the tangent directions already supplied by Z.
The image in V is its intersection with the range of L.
A crossing is still a failure of injectivity.
